**The original DPO paper doesn't report an AlpacaEval 2 win rate.** Rafailov et al. (2023) was released before AlpacaEval 2 existed. It evaluated on IMDb sentiment generation, TL;DR summarization and Anthropic HH dialogue, using GPT-4-judged win rates against reference or preferred responses. For example, DPO reached about 61% on TL;DR at temperature 0.

You may have seen DPO as a **baseline** in later papers that do use AlpacaEval 2. The most commonly cited numbers come from the SimPO paper (Meng et al., 2024), quoted from memory, so please verify:

| Setting | LC win rate | Raw win rate |
|---|---|---|
| Mistral-7B Base + DPO | ~15.1% | ~12.5% |
| Mistral-7B Instruct + DPO | ~26.8% | ~24.9% |
| Llama-3-8B Base + DPO | ~18.2% | ~15.5% |
| Llama-3-8B Instruct + DPO | ~40.3% | ~37.9% |

Zephyr-7B-β, a well-known DPO-trained model, scores roughly 13% LC and 11% raw on the AlpacaEval 2 leaderboard.

If you have a specific paper in mind, tell me which one or share the file. Your working directory is currently empty, so I can't check a local copy.
